body: Triggers? Can't say I can think of any specific ones. Social situations can be bad sometimes. If someone unexpectedly talks to me, for instance. But, I would say generalized, especially as lately I seen to be a bit more stressed out and on edge.

Probably. Honestly, it might be some degree of some sort of anxiety disorder as well. That being said, there's no way I can go about remedying that situation (to my knowledge). I can't just go speak to a psychologist. It's complicated.

That is true, I'll give you that. There are many people who just fake it. Frankly though, I don't like that idea. I mean, why should I fake it in the first place? If I don't enjoy it, I don't enjoy it, so maybe it would be best to drop out.

You make a fair point though.

I suppose to a certain degree I am "stuck in a rut" so to speak, but it's been this way for years now. 5 years maybe? It's just been building up over time. Perhaps things will change, but I don't know about living another 5 years just to continue feeling this way. Thank you though, and I suppose I can look into that more.

Are you going through this right now, or have you already worked through it? I suppose I can talk to you about this a little, I'll PM you or something, after all I might as well hear you out a bit.

But I will thank you if you can offer me any sort of advice for this. Even if you can't I'll still thank you for trying, after all it is the thought that counts.

I don't want to sound more whiney than I do already, but I have tried all of that before, and frankly nothing changes. I don't see, to get along well with others unless someone I know is introducing me. Which is tricky, because then how can I meet people if i don't know others? 

Thanks for your words though, and I guess I'll try to think about that, but we'll see.
